candidates.change_summary: Remove the balance increment so airDrop no longer credits the caller.
Change the airdrop amount from 20 to 10 so final balances differ.
Remove the unlock statement so after the first airDrop the contract stays locked and all subsequent calls revert.
Change the hasNoBalance guard to require a balance of 1 instead of 0, so airDrop reverts for callers with zero balance.
Change the expected token name string to 'Nu Tokon' so the supportsToken check fails for legitimate Bank callers.
Change the credited amount from 20 to 21 tokens so the resulting tokenBalance differs after a successful airDrop.
Remove the reset of _locked after the guarded body, so only the first airDrop succeeds and any later call reverts.
Invert the balance check to require a nonzero balance, so airDrop reverts for users with zero balance.
Change the token-name literal used in the keccak check so the supportsToken requirement never matches and airDrop always reverts.
Change the credit from adding 20 tokens to setting the balance to 40 tokens.
Delete the statement that credits 20 tokens so the caller's balance is never updated.
Delete the lock acquisition so airDrop can be re-entered during the supportsToken external call, allowing a double credit of 20 tokens.
Invert the token-name check so airDrop always reverts for legitimate callers, leaving tokenBalance unchanged.
